notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard independent named and default update-rate subscriptions. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and update-rate designator. It verifies that active named-rate best-effort attributes are gated independently while the default-rate reliable attribute continues to reflect, without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador update-rate lookup, publication, subscription, registration, update, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador independent update-rate subscription declarations
